description: This file contains utility functions for replacing ellipsis characters in files within a project, including a function to process individual files and a main function to locate resource folders and perform replacements.

methods.name: replaceEllipsisInFile
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of '...' with '…' in the specified file.

methods.name: replaceEllipsis
methods.description: Locates resource folders and replaces ellipsis in files within those folders.
